notes.title: Demo Update B0013
notes.notes:
Thanks again for all the feedbacks, here a new update (and probably the last one for this demo).

Demo B0013 (Minor patch) :

Fixed Critical issue: Game could hang and crash at new day (bug introduced in B0012)

Tweaked/QoL on Missions and strategic view
The source and destination buttons in the strategic view now dynamically generate both likely source and destination of the mission. And these buttons now open the object's context menu when available instead of setting a course directly.

Fixed: Passenger transport mission was broken
Also removed missions to transport generic passengers (since that's covered by passenger contract system). Transport mission only involves the transportation of simulated characters.

Tweaked: revised outlawing player mechanism + optimizations
- The damages dealt over time from the player now only tracks the damages to the hull that has effectively penetrated (deflected/shield damages are ignored) instead of counting all damages.
- The 'pissed-off' threshold is now 10% of hull HP instead of 1%
- Bounty scales according to the tracked damage value to the asset instead of fixed 1k$
- Player can no longer evade bounty by one-shooting a target
- The damage tracker is more reliable and fast
- AI is less forgetful of your past forfeits
- Tracked damage decay is now proportional to the ship's max hull HP to align with the existing 'pissed-off' threshold that is proportional as well

Tweaked (Scenario): QPH had the same faction color as the SAE
Fixed: spaceship total cargo capacity computation was broken

notes.title: Demo Update B0012
notes.notes:
To compensate for the late release (I have missed the mark for Steam 4x fest), the Demo will be available until the 23rd of August.

Work continues in improving accessibility to the game, with this minor patch:

* QoL: Added a warning system for missions",
A dynamic warning system, it analyzes the mission and give some hints of the mission difficulty or obstacles.Missions are not player-centric, but centered around the organization that issue them or the state of the simulation.
Warnings:
- (Severe) This mission requires docking at a HOSTILE location.
- (Caution) The mission destination is located far from your current position.
- (Sever) The mission destination is located at an extreme distance from your current position.
- (Caution) Insufficient crew berths available (can be freed).
- (Severe) Required crew berths cannot be provided.
- (Caution) Insufficient cargo space (can be freed).
- (Severe) Required cargo space cannot be provided.
- (Caution) The mission deadline will expire within 2 weeks.
- (Severe) The mission deadline will expire within 1 week.
- (Caution) The target is stronger than your current fleet.
- (Severe) The target is MUCH stronger than your current fleet.

Tweaked: Mouse selection on 'Galaxy Objects' is more accurate especially at higher zoom
[Tweaked/Fixed: 'Go to destination' for patrol mission set course to the next waypoint (instead of [wayoint's closest star)
Fixed critical issue: Character's context menu was not showing up
Fixed/Tweaked: Reworked how crew stats influence the spaceships modifiers
Fixed (Scenario): QPH was seen as a playable Organization
Tweaked: Added description for all skills with their in-game effects
Fixed: Player's date of birth was 0 A.D
Fixed: 'Select' in context menu works better

QoL: improvments on auto-navigation capabilities
'Travel to' now works for any interactable galaxy objects including outpost and colonies, some locations have 'auto-land' option / 'Travel to (vicinity)'

Fixed: Lock view on Outpost (or controlled spaceship landed on outpost) was not working
Fixed/QoL: Ships with a course set, now auto-undock when necessary to reach the destination
QoL: 'Go to' replaced to 'focus view' + auto close UI panels and extended to all objects

notes.title: Demo Update B0011
notes.notes:
This is a minor update with some bugfixes, tweaks and QoL:

* Added Q and E , P and Pause keys as shortcut to decrease/increase/pause the game
* Fixed: Diplomacy screen mismatch with Org name and relation
* Fixed: Player can no longer see enemy's missions (mission board)
* Fixed: Missions can no longer pick an identical source and destination
* Tweaked Scenario: Ship for sale have now default loadout instead of strategic missile
* Tweaked: Rebalanced mission's monetary rewards

* Fixed Critical Issue: Adding character to a crew (including city) to a non bridge role (such as passenger) was auto assigning them to an organization.
This caused grave but silent issue across the entire simulation including the political system (not featured in the demo), early spam of tiny individual corporation named 'player corp', which obvsiouly lacked capital to do anything. lack of recruitable personel and many other unseen issues."

* Tweaked: Organizations dynamically created from individuals during the game now inherit the founder's name"

* Fixed: Last name of (complex) characters was outputed twice across the entire program's UI",

notes.title: Demo Update B0010 + Navigation Tutorial
notes.notes:
The first day of the demo has passed. To help you play the Antimatter demo and future versions, I’ve started a series of concise tutorials. Here’s the first one, on spaceship navigation. More to come.

[previewyoutube=Yy7BHjIb7vc;full][/previewyoutube]

---

Patch note for B0010 (Minor update)

* Fixed: projectiles were invisible
* Tweaked: Max timescale to x32 instead of x256
* Fixed: Charisma (-) button was not working
* Tweaked: Editor Mode is no longer accessible by default (can be enabled in setting.json)
* Tweaked: Docking/landing set the timescale back to x1

* Fixed: Private Properties
Purchased assets with your own money (Private property) were not controllable as attributed assets. Private property inherit the controller's organization but doesnt count as allocated from the organization and don't penalize the player if it is destroyed.

* Fixed: Bought spacecrafts did not switch AI on.

* Tweaked: x1 time on detected threat
Time on detected threat has now a cooldown of 6 hours instead of 24h to leave more reaction time to player against incoming missiles

* Scenario tweak: The SAE is now stronger
The SAE now starts with a belt of 3 defensive spacestations with laser beam loadout + 3 patrolling task forces

* Fixed: Some changes in timescale was not propagated to the UI",

notes.title: Private Alpha - B0006 (The Giant Update)
notes.notes:
The Giant Update
Build 0006 is ready for the private alpha. If you're part of it, please read the important information at the bottom of this page.

This is a massive update, I've estimated that writing a full patch note would take me about two full days of work, which just isn’t worth it.

Instead, I'll highlight a few key changes:


Complete rework of the economy/production line simulation and lot of AI (build order, investment behaviour) work plus a complete overhaul of the UI.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/2cc434bb8e313aa659e349de3ec4771dba8c2c7d.png"]

Overhauled the trade node simulation.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/6fbb1cf91dcf44eaf9bb21d1bd2769c2e69c1dd1.png"]

Full scenario system (with a new playable scenario)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/7b413438639419da9809c7e15591e338b0b1d740.png"]

Doctrine/RoE system for spaceship/AI

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/fe0f418e91612a45752264cc7190cebeaa40708a.png"]

UI/UX rework: numerous tweaks including ship navigation, camera controls, keybindings, RTS-style selection, Time-on-Target orders, queued orders, improved interactions, new interface windows, and much much more.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/28092aeea54a39c9b018ad40fa5c03bbe8d95a9f.png"]

Space combat rework:  expanded weapons, reworked all ships, modules, and weapon stats; added many special behaviours; implemented sensor-based missile detection; improved the complex damage model; overhauled planetary bombardment mechanics; added nuclear blast effects (both in space and on the ground), and more.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/3abd09ca346dd420b3eae93ebb86611b51e353f7.png"]



Some graphical enhancements: improved gas and dust clouds, orbital bombardment effects, and more.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38944940/22d424ce2c5c965311020f5c32d9ff5980d1cb02.png"]

Reworked historical simulation

Reworked colonization mechanics

Improved atmospheric simulation and accretion model of planetary bodies

Massive improvements to AI and overall performance

Better performance, improved code maintainability, and reduced code volume

Production-level Lua support, expanded moddability, and broader localization

Countless bug fixes

Numerous tweaks and small feature additions



When starting the prologue : read your in-game mail.


There is a small performance drop (game hangs for 250-500ms) every day passing -> sorry about that, it Will be easily fixed: it is the lua (daily) script methods being recompiled each time instead of being cached virtually during call.

notes.title: Trade Lines - Version B0004 released (Private Alpha)
notes.notes:
A new video devlog about the main work of this week :

[previewyoutube=bgBcx_FeBGg;full][/previewyoutube]

And a new version was released the 4th of may
---------------------
PRIVATE ALPHA - Update B0004
---------------------
Release Date: 04-05-2025

Focus: Trade AI, UI/UX revision, improved missions, better planet rendering, and essential tweaks and fixes.

Trade Line system + UI/UX
A global system generating and tracking trade lines, used by AIs and the player.

Revised Trade AI
A major change to how trade opportunities are evaluated.

Trade node improvement
Overhauled trade node system to be much more reliable and efficient.

Better UI/UX for trade node
Trade node UI has been reworked entirely, and many tooltips and context menus were implemented.

Reworked and improved passenger transport AI
Passenger transport logic has been reworked for better behavior and planning.

Improved planet rendering
3 new types of forests, 3 new types of mountains, improved forest transitions, and implemented visual assets (added outpost graphics).

Localization: around a hundred new strings
Localization has been expanded with approximately 100 new strings.

Improved save/load with better version tracking/UI
Save/load interface now includes better version tracking and usability.

Sounds effects restored
Previously missing sound effects have been restored.

UI/UX: Added the strategic view
A new strategic view has been added to support large-scale decision-making.

Fixed icon scaling causing object lack visible strategic icons + some improvements on icons and text scaling and performances
Resolved issues with icon scaling and improved performance related to icons and text.

Fixed: Replicant nest generation was not affected by game settings and tweaked generation chances.
Nest generation now respects game settings and generation chances have been adjusted.

Fixed: mushrooms were competing with surface flora reigns, causing them to sometimes take over entire planets.

Impossible to land on planet in some situations
Fixed an issue where landing on planets could become impossible under certain conditions.

Disabled Sol system
The Sol system has been temporarily disabled.

Many fixes and tweaks
A wide range of additional minor fixes and adjustments have been made.
